people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jebusites
people.line: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest

people.name: Ornan
people.line: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David

translations.web: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
translations.bsb: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
translations.kjv: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
translations.asv: At that time, when David saw that Jehovah had answered him in the threshing-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
